## Working paper

### *Aspirational Renters? Housing-Market Deregulation and Prospects of Upward Mobility*

**Soonhwan Kwon**

Job-market paper. Presented at the 2026 American Political Science Association Annual Meeting.

This paper examines how housing-market deregulation changes renters' prospects of upward mobility and why those effects differ according to renters' economic capacity and proximity to homeownership.

[Abstract and project description](research.qmd#toward-homeownership)

## Works in progress

### *Mortgage Guarantees and Political Attitudes After Home Purchase: Evidence from the Netherlands*

**Soonhwan Kwon**

**Working title.** Examines whether public mortgage guarantees shape financial expectations and political preferences after renters become homeowners.

[Project description](research.qmd#into-homeownership)

### *Renting as an Alternative? Housing Support and Economic Security in New York City*

**Soonhwan Kwon**

**Working title.** Examines when renter-support policies can make renting a stable alternative to homeownership and how different policy designs shape economic security and political attitudes.

[Project description](research.qmd#outside-homeownership)

### *Perceived Inequality and Debt-Financed Homeownership: Evidence from South Korea and the United Kingdom*

**Soonhwan Kwon**

Investigates whether perceived inequality predicts debt-financed transitions from renting to owning among renters with different levels of financial capacity.
